article.title: Norman Finkelstein’s latest book indicts those ‘in high places’ for genocide in Gaza
article.author: James North
article.content: A review of Norman Finkelstein's 'Gaza's Gravediggers,' which indicts not Israel's military, but the global officials and institutions, such as the UN, the ICJ, and the media, who enabled and legitimized the genocide.
source_folders: 06_左派ニュース・社会主義戦略
